implications.says: at nine Dr. Mott was three miles off, in the sergeant's sight: it was not he at the side door
she knew the figure by the cloak alone, and that night someone other than the doctor wore it
so what Mrs. Lunn saw stands, and her naming the doctor does not
the cloak cleared the ground on the one who wore it, and on Kitty it would have trailed: it was not Kitty
only Mr. Pell and Kitty, beside the doctor, could let themselves out at the side door, and it was neither the doctor nor Kitty: it was Mr. Pell
